the bundlesize isn't reported in the "checks" section here 🤔  https://travis-ci.org/algolia/instantsearch.js/jobs/501931671 logs aren't totally clear

I've noticed Bundlesize was sometimes skipped on some PRs. I'm not sure if this is what's happening here (because the PR was originally opened without Bundlesize set up), or if it's not picked up.

We can try like this – if Bundlesize is not triggered on other PRs, we can add it back to the `functional-tests` script.

`bundlesize` won't ever work with this setup, we run it against the build output. With what we have now we never run the build before `bundlesize`. This is the reason why it was in `functional-test` it avoid to build the source multiple time in multiple jobs. Worst case we have to add the `build` step before the call.
Right, it makes sense! Will revert this change.
